messages.subject: compile simNodesMV
parts:
Hi everybody,

I thought I could use a compiled version of simNodesMV as in the example. But it doesn't seem to work. Any idea what I am missing?

Example:

library(nimble)

code <- nimbleCode({
    x ~ dnorm(0,1)
})

myModel <- nimbleModel(code)
myMV <- modelValues(myModel)
Rsim <- simNodesMV(myModel, myMV)

cModel <- compileNimble(myModel)
Csim <- compileNimble(Rsim, project = myModel)

# does not work
Csim$run(2)
NULL
myMV['x']
[NA]

# works
Rsim$run(2)
myMV['x']
[[1]]
[1] -0.8845291

[[2]]
[1] -0.2874019

messages.author: dd632bd3bbcdd7e9
messages.subject: Re: compile simNodesMV
parts:
Hi Patrick,

What's going on is there is a compiled counterpart to myMV.  There are other ways you could access it in more involved code, but in your example the simplest way would be

as.matrix(Csim$mv)

I'll file an issue that this is not really clear in the documentation. 

-Perry
